Module 2.title: Fundamental Rights & Directive Principles
Module 2.diagram_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 500 130' style='width:100%;max-width:480px;height:auto;background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin:10px auto;display:block;'><text x='20' y='25' fill='#38bdf8' font-size='13' font-weight='bold'>Fundamental Rights (Part III, Articles 12-35)</text><text x='80' y='75' fill='#38bdf8' font-size='13'>Equality (14-18) • Freedom (19-22) • Exploitation (23-24) • Religion (25-28) • Remedies (32)</text></svg>
Module 2.short_notes:
⚡ High-Yield Exam Summary • 24MCT506 Module 2
📐 Core Governing Equations
  • Article 21: Protection of Life and Personal Liberty (expanded to include right to privacy, clean environment, education).
  • Article 32: Constitutional Remedies via Supreme Court Writs: Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Prohibition, Certiorari, Quo-Warranto.
📌 Essential Concepts & Rules
  • Fundamental Rights vs DPSP: FRs are justiciable (enforceable by courts); DPSPs (Part IV) are non-justiciable socio-economic goals.
💡 2-Minute Exam Revision Tips
  • Dr. Ambedkar termed Article 32 the 'Heart and Soul' of the Constitution.

Module 3.title: Union Executive & Parliament
Module 3.diagram_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 500 130' style='width:100%;max-width:480px;height:auto;background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin:10px auto;display:block;'><text x='20' y='25' fill='#38bdf8' font-size='13' font-weight='bold'>Union Governance Architecture</text><text x='90' y='75' fill='#10b981' font-size='13'>President (Nominal Head) + Council of Ministers (PM Real Head) + Parliament</text></svg>
Module 3.short_notes:
⚡ High-Yield Exam Summary • 24MCT506 Module 3
📐 Core Governing Equations
  • Parliament Composition: President + Rajya Sabha (Council of States, permanent) + Lok Sabha (House of the People, 5-yr term).
  • Article 74: Council of Ministers headed by Prime Minister to aid and advise the President.
📌 Essential Concepts & Rules
  • Money Bill (Article 110): Can be introduced only in Lok Sabha with President's prior recommendation; Rajya Sabha cannot reject.
💡 2-Minute Exam Revision Tips
  • The executive is collectively responsible to Lok Sabha (Article 75(3)).
Module 3.detailed_notes:
Comprehensive Engineering Analysis • Union Administration

Parliamentary Democracy Mechanics

Legislative procedure, ordinances (Article 123), and budgetary financial bills.

Module 4.title: State Executive & Judiciary
Module 4.diagram_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 500 130' style='width:100%;max-width:480px;height:auto;background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin:10px auto;display:block;'><text x='20' y='25' fill='#38bdf8' font-size='13' font-weight='bold'>Indian Unified Judiciary Hierarchy</text><text x='110' y='75' fill='#ef4444' font-size='14'>Supreme Court → High Courts → Subordinate District Courts</text></svg>
Module 4.short_notes:
⚡ High-Yield Exam Summary • 24MCT506 Module 4
📐 Core Governing Equations
  • Integrated Judiciary: Single unified judicial system enforcing both union and state laws.
  • Article 226: High Court powers to issue writs for Fundamental Rights and other legal rights (broader than Art 32).
📌 Essential Concepts & Rules
  • Governor Powers: Constitutional head of state, holds office during pleasure of President.
💡 2-Minute Exam Revision Tips
  • Supreme Court is court of record and custodian of Constitution with judicial review powers.

Module 5.title: Emergency Provisions & Centre-State Relations
Module 5.diagram_svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 500 130' style='width:100%;max-width:480px;height:auto;background:#0f172a;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin:10px auto;display:block;'><text x='20' y='25' fill='#38bdf8' font-size='13' font-weight='bold'>Constitutional Emergency Provisions</text><text x='90' y='75' fill='#f59e0b' font-size='13'>National (Art 352) • State / President's Rule (Art 356) • Financial (Art 360)</text></svg>
Module 5.short_notes:
⚡ High-Yield Exam Summary • 24MCT506 Module 5
📐 Core Governing Equations
  • Three Types of Emergencies: National Emergency (Art 352 - war, external aggression, armed rebellion); State Emergency (Art 356 - failure of constitutional machinery); Financial Emergency (Art 360).
  • Seventh Schedule Lists: Union List (97 subjects), State List (66 subjects), Concurrent List (47 subjects).
📌 Essential Concepts & Rules
  • Federal Character: Quasi-federal system: 'Federal in structure, unitary in spirit'.
💡 2-Minute Exam Revision Tips
  • During national emergency, federal structure transforms into unitary system without constitutional amendment.
Module 5.detailed_notes:
